zh: 新增一键垃圾清理：深度扫描清理第三方应用缓存、系统崩溃日志与残留安装包，释放存储空间
智能安全白名单：严格保护 IPTV 等关键电视软件与桌面核心排版，不清除账号与登录状态
极简清理确认与即时反馈：清理前优雅弹窗确认，清理后实时提示释放的存储空间大小
en: One-Click Junk Clean: Deep scan and clean third-party app caches, crash logs, and residual APK files to free up storage
Intelligent Safety Whitelist: Strictly protects IPTV and launcher settings to preserve logins and preferences
Clean Confirmation & Feedback: Minimalist glass confirmation dialog with instant feedback on freed storage space

zh: 控制中心纵向滚动支持：主面板开启平滑纵向滚动，适配各类电视屏幕，选项全部完整可见
恢复默认排版优化：位置上调至系统维护区域（一键授权下方），排版一目了然更易操作
全新 Wi-Fi 体验升级：支持纯英文键盘直接输入，自动聚焦输入框，连接更稳定便捷
首次使用向导：新机或恢复出厂后，智能检测并提示一键初始化官方排版与必备影视应用
Root 智能静默授权与 AOT Speed 机器码优化：全速编译优化大幅提升电视流畅度
en: Control Center Scrolling: Added smooth vertical scrolling to the main panel, ensuring all options are fully visible on any screen
Reset Layout Optimization: Moved 'Reset to Default Layout' to system maintenance section right under Permissions
Wi-Fi Connection Upgrades: Added pure English keyboard mode, auto-focus password input, and improved connection stability
First-Time Setup Guide: Automatically prompts to initialize standard official layout and essential media apps
Root Silent Permissions & AOT Speed Optimization: One-click optimization for lightning-fast TV performance

zh: 全新 Wi-Fi 体验升级：支持纯英文键盘直接输入，自动聚焦输入框，连接更稳定便捷
首次使用向导：新机或恢复出厂后，智能检测并提示一键初始化官方排版与必备影视应用
Root 智能静默授权：Root 设备自动开启无障碍极速安装助手，并支持一键静默授予全部应用权限
AOT Speed 极致优化：控制中心新增一键全速机器码编译优化，大幅提升电视流畅度与冷启动速度
en: Wi-Fi Connection Upgrades: Added pure English keyboard mode, auto-focus password input, and improved connection stability
First-Time Setup Guide: Automatically prompts to initialize standard official layout and essential media apps
Smart Root Permissions: Auto-enables Accessibility Assistant on rooted devices and grants all app permissions in one click
AOT Speed Machine Code Optimization: Added one-click AOT Speed optimization in Control Center for lightning-fast performance

zh: 云端标准排版还原：一键从云端拉取标准化排版（5大分类文件夹与第一排常用），自动还原
智能一键清理：恢复排版时自动安全清理非官方自装应用，严密保护系统组件与电视核心服务
必备应用按需补齐：支持可选（optional）与核心应用识别，缺失的核心影音自动下载安装
稳定性与无障碍极速安装助手优化
en: Cloud Master Layout Restore: One-click sync from cloud to restore standard 5 categorized folders and dock
Smart App Cleanup: Automatically and safely clean unauthorized third-party apps while strictly protecting system services
Essential App Rules: Flexible core vs optional app management with auto-download for missing core apps
Fast Install Assistant and system stability improvements

zh: 控制中心一键恢复默认排版：一键还原官方默认桌面排版，并自动检测补齐核心影音软件
新增极速安装助手：基于无障碍自动快速确认应用安装与权限，免反复按遥控器
个性化设置优化：新增极速安装助手开/关控制项
全量多语言更新与系统体验优化
en: One-click default layout restore: Reset home screen to official layout in Control Center with auto-install for missing core apps
Fast Install Assistant: Accessibility-based automatic confirmation of app installation and permissions
Personalization toggle: Easily enable or disable Fast Install Assistant
Multilingual improvements and performance tuning

zh: 后台音频智能静音：按 Home 键回到桌面时自动接管音频焦点并暂停后台播放，杜绝影视软件偷跑声音
全新多语言升级：新增韩语（한국어）与日语（日本語）原生支持
核心影视应用智能配置：恢复默认布局或首次安装时支持一键补齐核心影音
潘多拉影视智能识别：支持 6.0+ 最新版本检测与无缝更新升级
IPTV 智能适配：仅在电视已安装时显示在第一排，未安装不打扰提醒
en: Smart Background Audio Muting: Returns to Home immediately silence and pause background media players
Multilingual upgrade: Added native Korean (한국어) and Japanese (日本語) support
Core streaming apps setup: One-click download/install for core entertainment apps
Smart Pandora TV detection: Automatic v6.0+ version verification and upgrade
IPTV smart placement: Preserved in dock when present without missing-app nag

zh: 全新多语言升级：新增韩语（한국어）与日语（日本語）原生支持
核心影视应用智能配置：恢复默认布局或首次安装时支持一键补齐核心影音
潘多拉影视智能识别：支持 6.0+ 最新版本检测与无缝更新升级
en: Multilingual upgrade: Added native Korean (한국어) and Japanese (日本語) support
Core streaming apps setup: One-click download/install for core entertainment apps
Smart Pandora TV detection: Automatic v6.0+ version verification and upgrade

zh: 修复冷启动/重启时桌面偶现屡次停止的系统兼容性问题
修复个性化「主屏幕」设置项向下滚动后遥控器往上移动卡住并跳顶的问题
全面新增「繁體中文」支援（支援台灣與香港慣用語，並自動識別系統繁體）
en: Fixed direct-boot crash on device restart before unlock
Fixed D-pad Up navigation trap and jump issue in Home Screen settings
Added full Traditional Chinese (zh-TW, zh-HK) language support
